nom: Mario Badescu Super Collagen Mask with Marine Collagen

avis.texte: Holy cow. I've never had a mask make my skin feel so smooth, and it lasts! You also dont have to use a lot- just a thin layer goes a long way, and you leave it on for 15-20 minutes before washing it off. I apply it twice a week before bedtime. If you havent tried it yet, you should do so immediately! You won't regret it 😊

I've tried a lot of masks (peel-off, gel, clay, etc.) and am really enjoying this one. It's less drying than a lot of clay masks and it leaves my skin feeling cleansed, toned and energized. Great price point, too - new favorite!
Feels really nice on the skin, and after using for a week you can see the difference.
honestly one of my favorite masks I purchased. very hydrating, firming, and helps prevent breakouts.
Awesome! This mask leaves my oily skin t-zone balanced, shrinks my pores and smooths my textured skin! A little goes a long way and my skin feels like I just had an expensive facial! 10/10

I LOVE THIS MASK!! I've noticed a significance decrease of blemishes just from using this mask, theres not any pore cloggers and its fungal acne free! You cant beat the price either, my new favorite mud mask < 3
I've got this mask as a free gift with purchase. it is very thick. hard to apply to skin.

I purchased this because i read somewhere that Martha Stewart uses this mask. Have y'all seen how good Martha looks at 82 years old??? Any who…shes on to something. This mask is gentle on my sensitive skin. While wearing it you can feel tightening effects. My pores look much smaller after use and the oil in my t-zone is under control. It smells…medicinal but not in a bad way. This is a mask I will purchase over and over again. Out of the many masks ive tried, this one is probably in spot #1 for me. It does exactly what i want a face mask to do. Tighten, brighten, and shrink my pores. Love it!!!

I got this last week and super excited to try because it's super collagen. I have a normal skin, I could change any skincares from different brands and never had any problem before, but when I tried this for the first time, my face got really really dry, and now get redness on ny cheeks. It smells like a baby powder, and when I checked the ingredients, they use talc. Idk if this is good for face, and how they can claim this powdery mask as a super collagen mask?
I recommend this product, just be sure to use a hevay moisturizer after because it can be drying. I notice a big positive difference after using every few weeks
Makes my skin look great. Nice addition to my masking collection.

I followed the instructions exactly the night I bought this mask. I was so excited to try it. The next day, I woke up with dry, red, painful skin. It is now day 3 since I have used it and my face still hurts. My face is so dry and even itchy. I have actually taking ibuprofen and benedryl, just to be able to sleep and have any comfort. Disappointed is an understatement, criminal is more appropriate. I am ditching the whole brand bc of this experience.

Received as a deluxe sample in a bonus gift w/purchase. Smell is terrible and it dried out my skin in an awful way. My skin felt like I had a terrible sunburn, leathery, etc. Will not ever use again and can not recommend.

avis.titre: One of the best face masks I've ever tried!
avis.texte: I am obsessed with this mask! have been using it for over a month now and the changes I'm seeing are incredible! Immediately after washing the mask off, my skin is visibly more plump and smooth! I am receiving endless compliments on my skin and have told every single one of my friends and family about this miracle in a jar!! I HIGHLY recommend trying it out for yourself.
I have combination skin and this was very drying. I'll try it again in the summer. Did feel it helped clear my T zone of black heads a bit.

I'm a licensed esthetician and have always liked Mario Badescu products. I received a sample of this and saw insane, immediate results. I already have good skin thanks to my profession and genetics. But after I washed this off the first time I was shocked at how amazing my skin looked. It was glowing, plump, looked younger and had an overall healthy look to it. I already use tons of products and use an acid peel every few weeks. I've never been as stunned by one use of a product before. After my sample ran out I've continued to purchase this. I use it 3 times a week. I get compliments on my skin regularly. Some is obviously from the array of products I use but I've noticed right after I use this mask I get a lot of compliments. It's like a miracle in a jar. It out performs $200 skincare products. I'll never stop using this.

i was skeptical about this product, not knowing how this brand would react to my skin, but hearing a lot of positive reviews from friends i went for it. im so glad i did. its cold, and easily spreads on your skin. my skin feels healthy, and glows. the only thing is the smell, and which isnt exactly the most pleasant, but i can tolerate it.

I was shocked at the results! I've used so many masks over the years and have struggled with my skin since I was in my teens. This product is a must have. The results are immediate and effective. I will be incorporating this into my skin routine indefinitely. And what a great price!!!

i live for this mask! i've heard many people say start incorporating collagen into your routine.. while you're still young. so im taking this advantage while i'm 18. anywho.. this mask is my go to, i love how youthful and beautiful it makes me look.

I have not used this for long, but my first experience was that it did make my skin look healthy and glowing. I found it a little hard to spread evenly and my face looked a little red after rinsing off, but it was temporary. I will continue to use and see what results it brings. I am new to masks, so usually you have to use a product long enough to give it a chance and see results. So far, I like it.

I'm a licensed esthetician and I can't live without this. I have access to professional products that are amazing but this one is just as good and inexpensive. I absolutely shocked when I rinsed it off the first time and saw how my skin looked. I already have great skin because of my profession and this made it look even better. I've been using it for a couple years now. It's great for mature skin. Collagen is important when you get older as your body starts to lose it. I can't recommend this enough.
It helped clear out black head and build up on my face! Smells refreshing and goes on really smooth! Will definitely be buying this forever now!

I love this mask. it leaves my skin in great condition after use. it helps rejuvenate my skin and gives it a tight glow. that makes it very satisfying. I use this mask after working all day, I cook dinner in it and wash it off before bed. adding oil and moisturizer after I wash it off

no bc i did not expect it to be this great 😩 i've had super stubborn breakouts that won't go away and i used this ONCE and woke up with significantly better skin i would sell my soul for this face mask

Definitely one of my favorite products from this brand alongside with their face mists and night cream. Once you exfoliate, put this mask on and let magic happen. You will notice your skin supple, hydrated and soft after using it.
I used it on my cousins face and it drew out impurities just like it said it would even his pimples popped on their own while wearing the mask
It's pretty good. But for a collagen mask it leaves my skin a little dry. (I have combo skin) not sure if I would purchase again
I love this mask it's kept my skin so soft and clear and it's reasonably priced. Will buy again!

avis.titre: Will forever invest in this product
avis.texte: Use this product with the rest of my skin care line about 2-3 times weekly. Has AMAZING results! Best facial mask ever! Reduced my wrinkles and cleared out impurities leaving my skin so soft and silky. Love how it is gentle for my sensitive skin so no irritation. Best investment ever. HIGHLY recommend this product.
The mask does leave a little difference, and I can get several uses out the jar. Therefore, I feel I've gotten my money's worth. I have had better though. This does not wow me.
My skin loves this so much. My only complaint odd that I with it was available in larger sizes!

I've only used this a few times and my skin is softer and it has a little glow to it. I feel like I even look nice with only mascara and lip gloss. My husband thought I had on foundation a few times and I didn't. I am even more convinced that Mario Badescu has the best skincare.
This is a nice mask. It feels rich and washes off well. Skin feels great after using it.

One of my favorite masks. A little goes a long way and has my skin looking super nice. While it dries it gives a nice tight feeling, I like doing it before a shower and wash it off after it dries. Make sure you have a good moisturizer for after just to finish off with a good hydrating feeling

avis.titre: A New Staple In My Mask Collection
avis.texte: I'm on my 6th jar now. I especially love using this at night because when I wake my face looks fresh and dewy. Also, my go to mask to use before video chats. I def would say it does plump up your skin and it helps with it looking full but like anything else, it's especially important to keep up on your water intake and make sure to moisturize regularly to keep your skin healthy and supple. On that note, not a miracle product but with a healthy skin and body routine, this mask is pretty bomb. Only downside is there are a few ingredients In this product that I wish they would eliminate.
I'll restock my Super Collagen Mask every time I run out until they change the formulation. It's a quality product.

I have super large eye bags to the point my skin literally sags under my eyes. I used it once and they halfed in size. My skin also felt a lot smoother. I couldn't believe how soft my skin felt. I have never had a skin care product feel so nice. It smells good too.
I use this mask two to three times a week in rotation with two other masks. Especially during the winter, it's difficult to keep skin moist, firm, and glowing. This mask really helps.
I used this mask at night before sleep and my skin was glowing. The next day I took an unfiltered selfie on Instagram. Need I say more?

I love this mask for when my skin needs a pick-me-up! It goes on smooth and doesn't get tight or uncomfortable when drying. I have somewhat sensitive skin which is not irritated by this mask. For about 48 hours after use my face does indeed look more plump, firm and fresh. I follow with a moisturizer and/or serum for extra glow. :)
Went through an entire container thinking it was going to do something remarkable for my skin. It did absolutely nothing.
This is one of my favorite masks. It leaves my skin looking tighter, healthier, and brighter. The more often you use it, the better results you will see.
This is a fantastic mask. After using I can see improved skin tone and texture. It made my face really smooth, clean and soft.
I love this mask. It makes my skin feel so soft and supple after using
My skin has been changing the older I get and I feel like this mask really brought it back to the youthful ness it was. I only used it once and I noticed the changes

I love this mask! Even though it says not to use in eye area I use it almost every time I face mask right on my under eyes to tighten up my fine lines! Never irritates or dries out my skin. Some people might think it's expensive for a mask like I first did but it is definitely worth the money!
I've used it 4 times now . Each time I've gotten several pimples afterwards .

avis.titre: Made my skin look and feel rejuvenated
avis.texte: The Collagen mask made my skin feel so fresh after just one use!

I bought this on a whim because I wasn't happy with the masks I've been using but this is a game changer. I saw an extreme difference after one use! It really does clean out the pores well and brightens your complexion. The puck is pretty small but it's definitely worth it!
It made my friend and I's face feel so smooth and soft after the first use.

I used this for the first time last night and omg I cant believe the difference after only 1 use. I am obsessed. I can't wait to use it again. After waking up this morning I see a huge difference in my skin. It is tighter and brighter. I don't know how I went all these years without trying it. So glad I found you

avis.titre: One of my holy grail products
avis.texte: I have repurchased this mask over and over... and over again. It never fails me. I am 32 and enjoy my skincare products more than I ever have over the last 2 years. My boyfriend now enjoys mask night because of the results her sees and feels after rinsing it off. This definitely helps to smooth fine wrinkles, it also helps to bring out a healthy glow! If you are on the fence... take the leap and purchase this mask. You won't regret it.
I loved the way it makes your skin look afterward. Skin has a glow and a youthful look.

I always am so skeptical when I read a review that says it made a difference after one use. So I was shocked when I looked in the mirror after washing this mask off and my skin was luminous. I already have very good skin thanks to my knowledge of esthetics from being a cosmetologist. I thought my skin already was glowing. Nope. This mask made is glow like no product I've ever used. I'm 37 with only tiny wrinkles around my eyes when I smile and I'm trying to keep it that way by using prescription retinol and glycolic peels. This mask just upped the game. I can't say enough good things about it. It was pretty hard to get off my face with a washcloth and I had to scrub a little. That's the only downside I can even think of. I'm so impressed right now. If you want that popular luminous, dewy skin look, get this mask.

I absolutely love this mask. I just bought it Monday and started using it Tuesday(today is Saturday), and I already see a difference in my skin tone. I've had rosacea for since early middle school(I'm 23 now), and this has really toned down the redness to give my skin an overall smoother, cooler look and feel to it. Keep in mind that due to quarantine in my state and me being sick this week, I haven't worn makeup at all since last week, and I've basically been living off green tea, but I still think this mask made a great impact on my skin! Nonetheless, it smells great and works well as a way to relax my skin at night. Highly recommend!

I'm 40 and have had crepey, baggy skin under my eyes along with dark circles. I have recently been improving my skin care routine for my under eyes and in addition to more topical moisture, I've added this mask to my daily routine. I will only apply this mask to the area under my eyes ( I know it says to avoid the eye are in the instructions, but I have never gotten it in my eyes and it hasn't irritated my under eye area, even though I have SUPER sensitive skin). When I get up in the morning, I immediately apply while I prep my lunches and what not...then wash it off right before I'm getting ready to put my face on for the day. After rinsing off, the area under my eyes feel much tighter and looks smooth. I noticeably have less lines and the skin is not crepey.
When I want to pamper myself I use this mask.It makes my skin feel and look great.
I've only used this a few times now but overall it's been great! My skin feels refreshed and looks more radiant.

This mask goes on cool and thick and it'll start to dry down and crack like a clay mask. Usually, this terrifies me as my dry skin doesn't want to feel more cracked and miserable! At that point, I wash off the mask and my skin feels soft, refreshed and ready for even more hydrating products. It's very kind to my sensitive, dry skin!

avis.titre: Decent for the price and quality
avis.texte: First off I love the smell, some dont like it but to me it smells like nothing I've ever smelt before, and it's quite lovely! I have dry sensitive skin and this doesnt dry it out or cause a reaction. For a clay mask, that's rare and I'm lucky to have discovered it. it's a really nice creamy light blue color, it doesnt come with a lot, I'm already half way through and it's my second time using it but I will continue to buy since its relatively inexpensive compared to my other skincare products. It dries like a clay but it doesnt burn or feel drying to the skin. I think you will like it for a little self care and pampering, and to enjoy the aroma while you relax. One thing to note is that I use it on my whole neck too so that might play a big part in why I'm going through it fast. Just try it out it's really enjoyable!

I have sensitive combination skin for reference. When I first put the mask on I noticed the scent was strange and bothered me the whole time while wearing the mask. After taking it off, my skin felt dried out and burned after I put my moisturizer on. Overall I wanted to like this product but I don't think it was good for my sensitive skin!

avis.titre: shocked that it actually did something
avis.texte: honestly whenever i buy a face mask i expect it to do nothing but this one did. it made my skin look and feel so nice after one use! it's one of my go to's now and i highly recommend.

This is an easy mask for your at home spa time. I use it 2-3x a week and I love the way this makes my skin feel plump and moisturized after use. It's an inexpensive masks (compared to what's on the market these days) that delivers a decent result.

avis.titre: Does exactly what it says, great mask!!
avis.texte: The first time I used this it didn't break me out and I noticed my fine lines on my forehead were gone! It made my skin brighter and moisturized:) I loveee this mask so much and I love the way it comes off, it's not clumpy it's like a face wash consistency.

avis.titre: I will never not have this in my skincare regimen!!
avis.texte: I use this product 2-3 times a week. Never had any issues with breakouts or any reactions to my sensitive skin. My skin is left feeling very soft. Highly recommend!

This is the only product I have ever used in my life that right after I remove it, my fine lines and wrinkles are diminished and smoothed after just one application. If you also have dry, tired skin this is perfect for replenishment as well.
I use this product at least once a week and it refreshes and plumps your skin! After using, my wrinkles and fine lines are reduced and my skin feels moisturized and smooth. Love this product!

My first MB mask and now a staple in my routine. I have acne prone, combo/oily skin and this mask really helped to calm and even out my skin. After just the first use my face looked bright, hydrated, and healthy!

I have tried about 8-10 Mario Badescu products and have been loving them. I was excited to try this one, but I regret ever trying it. Things to know: I have sensitive skin, oily t-zone and the rest is dry. This product was not only hard to put on, but didn't smell good. I could get over the smell as long as it gave results but it obviously didn't work for me. Two minutes in, I began to sneeze several times and felt my skin was burning. I took it off right away and my skin was still tingling. Long story short: I'm allergic and now I have a rash on my face :(
My skin always feels so amazing after I use this! Easy to apply but dries quick. Leaves my face feeling like I just got a facial at home.
I use retinol on my skin a couple times a month and my skin peels and becomes dry and sensitive. Using this mask there's no irritation and it's very hydrating. Very good price. Smells great.

avis.titre: I have tried everything and this is magical
avis.texte: It is amazing. I put it on before I tan or wear makeup. Makes my skin perfect for a night out. Highly recommended !!
This is my third jar and will never not have one. Amazing product and price.

avis.titre: This I have yet to try.
avis.texte: I'll be leaving a comment at a later time when I am able to actually try this product out.

I have (had) large pores on my nose and nothing helped them until I tried this mask. I was super excited when I took off the mask and WOW I could not believe it. The next day my pores still look smaller!! I am a product JUNKIE in search of something that works and I finally found it. Also my marionette lines for half gone after one use. Firmer skin and so soft.
This kinda burned my sensitive skin, and then dried it out. Then I used it again and felt no burning and I took of the mask but I didn't feel much of a difference. Not impressed.

This works! I wasn't expecting much, but now I'm hooked! The natural ingredients make this even better. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, and diminish fine line within one use. I purchased this in the anti-aging kit, and now I'm gonna purchase a full size!

Love using this every other day! My wrinkles and fine lines show improvement after using. My face always feels so clean and fresh as well after use. I recommend to anyone looking for a nice collagen mask.

This mask just really firms everything up and makes it smooth. I have very dry skin and I can do this mask, add a good moisturizer after and I could leave the house with no makeup and feel good about it.

This is my favorite, go to mask at the moment. I feel refreshed, smooth, and moisturized afterwards. It gives me a healthy, shiny (in a good way) glow. I've read reviews where it dries out in the jar too quickly. I'm on my second jar and no problems? A review suggested keeping the foil top on, peel it back when you need to use it. Seems to work, haven't had issues. Love it!

avis.titre: period life saver + great for dry skin
avis.texte: I have super sensitive skin that breaks out to everything and this is great! I also have really dry skin from eczema, after I take it off I put a nice thick layer of lotion on and my skin is super soft! It's also great if you're like me and break out harde core on your period where it's not pimples, just random raised bumps and red inflamed skin! Takes away redness almost completely. If yours drys out (like mine did because I didn't put the lid on) just add some water and it's good as new!

I received this in the Ulta fav's skincare holiday box. Just used to last night and left it on for 20-25 minutes. My skin felt SO smooth afterwards. I followed up with my serum and moisturizer and woke up with my skin feeling so soft and looking plump. My smooth skin peeled through my make up and looked great all day. Will definitely buy the full size as soon as I run out!

I was looking for a mask to address texture and aging; but also a mask that was non-irritating. This collagen mask is great; my skin feels pampered and soft after each use. Fine lines / acne scarring are improved.

This was a gift for my sister. She wanted for the Masqueology Hyaluronic acid gummy mask, but you have to buy that online. A lovely Ulta lady recommended this one instead and she says it makes her face look just as good as the other mask!! Thank you Ulta lady, I appreciate you!!
Not a fan of this product as after one use, it totally dried out my skin. Definitely would not recommend for those with combination or dry skin.

I bought this product with no real expectation's, other than I love Mario Badescu products. I have acne/oily skin along with some lines and "double chin" which is genetic. After the first use my skin felt tighter and brighter. I have used it 4 times now in the last 2 weeks and notice firmer skin, brighter/more even skin tone, and my "double chin" seems to have firmed up some as well. This product worked way better than I expected and I plan to continue to use it 2x a week from here on out. And, it's very affordable, just like all of their products!

avis.titre: Good products but keeps drying out.
avis.texte: So I've bought this mask twice because I liked it and both of them have dried out before I finished them. The first one started to get hard after about a month. Then it was getting super hard to get out and I couldn't even put If on. About a month later it was hard as a rock. I rebought because I liked it and the exact same thing happened. I did my absolute best to take care of it cause I was afraid it was going to happen. I'm honestly shocked no one has mentioned this in the reviews. I tried adding oils and even heating it up and I ended jk throwing If away because it was just cimpletely dried. So sad. I really did like it but has to throw both away and that's not okay.

I bought this mask about 6 months ago to use before my wedding. It's a little pricey, but it's worth it. It makes my pores look smaller and helps tame my acne. It's also gotten rid of some fine lines. The smell is also great. It has a light cucumber scent. Many customers complain that it dries out. I've use 2 jars so far and I've found that covering it with the foil under the lid (leave the foil seal partially attached) doesn't allow it to dry out. Just make sure to tighten the lid as tight as possible and your shouldn't have a problem!
I love to use this product in the morning because I can instantly see a difference! This mask makes you ~glow~!

avis.titre: Good mask with not so good ingredients
avis.texte: I've been using this mask for a little over a month and like it quite well! It's easy to apply and dries like a clay mask. It tightens the skin as it dries but not to the point where it feels unpleasant. My skin always feels soft and very smooth after using this mask. However it does contain talc, fragrance, and methylparaben which are not the best ingredients.

I cannot say enough good things about this mask. I got it originally just to keep things a bit tight. It's done so much more. Since using the mask 2x a week starting in mid-May, my skin has transformed. Redness down. No acne. The works. This may be a case of correlation vs causation but whatever it is, I'll take it. My skin feels its best the day after doing this so it's a great mid-week pick me up treat and a way to get ready for the weekend.
I've been using this product for a couple years , great brand with good results and a great price for what the product can do
It dried my face and burned my side of nose. Would not recommend. I dont even have sensitive skin so this was weird.

I purchased this after having gone on vacation and gotten a lot more sun on my face than I intended. Felt like I needed a good pampering. Yes, the price persuaded me as i do not like to shell out tons of money for something that may or may not work. I think this mask is well worth the price and I love using it. I use as directed, every couple of days. It does have a smell, very clean linen-y which I enjoy but if you are put off by smells, maybe not for you? Anyway, I cleanse my face, put a thin layer of this on, wait 17 minutes, then wipe it off with a damp cloth. My skin feels great afterwards and stays well-hydrated despite the mask feeling very drying while its on my skin. I am a fan of other Mario Badescu products and same goes for this one. Will buy again and will recommend.
I have used it for a week and my face feels clear. I was told it would fade my acne scars and I am seeing it a little bit I hope my face evens out in time.

I love this product!!! So much that i told my mom to use it & she fell in love as well! It leaves our skin SUUUUUPER soft, & it gives our faces this natural glow! We both have oily skin, so we tend to look all shiny. But the glow that this mask gives you is a totally different glow. It makes me feel so confident with my skin that i usually end up not putting any make up on. Thanks mario!!!!

avis.titre: age 30-35 combination skin with mild acne
avis.texte: Love this Mask, using already 1 month, it does what it says!!! Love other skincare products from MARIO BADESCU, recommended to my friends and family!!! Affordable prices too...
I used this mask as directed at night before bed and my skin was super soft afterwards. I will continue to use this once or twice a week in my weekly regimen. I love Mario products!

To be honest, I'm not really sure what this mask is *supposed* to do, but what it does, is leave my face feeling incredibly soft, and is very calming, so much so that all my redness is completely gone when I was away the mask. I use every other day. A little goes a long ways, and will definitely repurchase.
This mask does exactly what it says it does. The first time I used it, it made my skin look and feel hydrated, plump, and glowy. I'm excited to see what results I'll get with continues use.

I love this face mask! I'm in my early 20's and was panicking when I noticed fine lines on my forehead. I use this mask twice a week and the fine lines are nearly gone. My skin glows and looks great after & Ive gotten compliments on my skin after using it:)
My skin feels so plump and alive with each use. It is like a face lift in a jar! This will be one lf my new go to products! Thank you Mario Badescu!

Best mask ever!!! It is so smooth and creamy when you put it on, it is a pretty color, and it smells amazing. I left it on for 20 minutes. When I washed it off, my skin tone was more even, all of my dry skin was gone, and my skin looked and felt so soft. Even my boyfriend tried it and loved it. I use several of Mario Badescu products and this is definitely one of my favorites. The only drawback is that it does contain parabens. Not sure why some of his products do and some don't. I try to avoid them but will continue to use this mask.

Love this mask. I'm in my mid-twenties so I'm all about prevention and really taking care of my skin now but still have pesky acne problems every now and then. This mask has truly turned my skin around on days when it's needed help, like when it's dull or really dry. Also, because of the collagen, I think it really helps discoloration and acne scars. When used consistently I've noticed it can reduce the healing time of an acne scar. One minor thing I've noticed and I know I'm not the only one is it dries out in the tub pretty quickly, so you're kind of forced to go through it pretty quickly.
Used it before bed and woke up with a nice smooth face. Skin was nice and plump

avis.titre: It's okay.  Makes your face feel refreshed.
avis.texte: I just started using it. It does make your face feel refreshed but too early to tell if it does anything else.

Really wanted to love this. My skin felt amazing for the first hour or so of rinsing the mask off... but then I started getting tons of itchy red patches all over my face and pimples everywhere (I literally never break out). It's been 3 days and I still have flakey dry patches that are driving me nuts. I will definitely be returning.
Did not notice a single difference. My skin actually felt better before using the mask. It is very watery and just drips everywhere.

avis.titre: Skin glows, but the mask smells
avis.texte: I decided to purchase this because my skin was drying out in the cold weather. This mask didn't disappoint! My skin looks and feels soft, hydrated, and glowing after using it, but the smell is very strong and off-putting. I have continued to use it because of the positive results - even though I dislike the odor.
I absolutely love this mask! My skin looks and feels better. Downfall is I can't stop touching my face after because it heels so soft and smooth!
This is was the first time I purchased this item. I used it on my very dry facial skin. The collagen did help somewhat but you have to use a few times a week to really get that hydrated skin.
I like this mask! It dries quickly but feels very good on my skin. A little goes a long way! The only con is the scent isn't the most pleasant, but once it starts drying the smell goes away.
I purchased this face mask when it was on sale during Ulta deal days and I am so glad I did. I LOVE it! The mask makes my skin look and feel amazing.
